2026-09-04GACSpecial Economic Measures ActRegulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Russia) Regulations Regulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Russia) Regulations in order to add eight (8) individuals to Schedule 1 of the Regulations; prohibiting them from transacting business with individuals and businesses in Canada and freezing their assets unless otherwise authorized by the Minister of the Foreign Affairs.Registration: SOR/2026-0188 Publication Date: 2026-09-23
subject: Regulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Russia) Regulations
precis: Regulations Amending the Special Economic Measures (Russia) Regulations in order to add eight (8) individuals to Schedule 1 of the Regulations; prohibiting them from transacting business with individuals and businesses in Canada and freezing their assets unless otherwise authorized by the Minister of the Foreign Affairs.
